response.justification: Bogdan's resume demonstrates extensive software engineering experience and expertise in multiple languages and frameworks, but lacks direct experience with SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator hardware, or deep-learning workload optimization—key requirements for this role. His background in web, mobile, and embedded systems is strong, but not aligned with the principal-level hardware/performance focus needed for AI accelerators in cloud infrastructure.
strengths: Strong software engineering background with expertise in multiple languages (C, C++, JavaScript, TypeScript, Dlang) and frameworks
Proven track record in performance optimization for low-latency applications and real-time systems
Experience with hardware-software co-design and embedded systems (e.g., robotic arms, Apple TV/iOS apps)
concerns: No explicit experience with SoC/IP modeling or AI accelerator architectures
Lacks direct involvement in deep-learning workload optimization or GPU architecture
No evidence of work with SIMD/MIMD architectures or system-on-chip design feedback
